molecules.name: Collagen Type I
molecules.label_th: คอลลาเจนชนิดที่ 1
molecules.role: ~80-85% of dermal collagen; triple helix of 2×α1(I) + 1×α2(I); gives tensile strength

molecules.name: Collagen Type III
molecules.label_th: คอลลาเจนชนิดที่ 3
molecules.role: ~8-15% of dermal collagen; dominant in fetal / young skin; elasticity and vascular support

molecules.name: Hyaluronic Acid (HA)
molecules.label_th: ไฮยาลูโรนิคแอซิด
molecules.role: Main dermal humectant — binds up to 1000× its weight in water; half-life in skin ~1 day; synthesized by HAS1/2/3

molecules.name: Elastin
molecules.role: Provides recoil/elasticity to skin; produced mainly during childhood — minimal replacement in adults; damaged by UV → solar elastosis

molecules.name: Ceramides (CER NS, NP, AS, AP, EOS)
molecules.role: ~50% of stratum corneum intercellular lipid mass; barrier integrity; synthesized from serine + palmitoyl-CoA

molecules.name: Retinol (Vitamin A alcohol)
molecules.role: OTC anti-aging active; must be 2-step oxidized (retinol → retinal → retinoic acid) in keratinocytes; ~1/20 potency of tretinoin

molecules.name: Retinoic Acid (Tretinoin, all-trans)
molecules.label_th: กรดเรตินอยอิก / ทริทินอยน์
molecules.role: Binds RAR/RXR nuclear receptors; clinically proven to reduce wrinkles + pigmentation (prescription only)

molecules.name: L-Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C)
molecules.label_th: กรดแอสคอร์บิก (วิตามินซี)
molecules.role: Cofactor for prolyl/lysyl hydroxylase (collagen crosslinks); tyrosinase inhibitor; neutralizes ROS; active only at pH <3.5

molecules.name: Niacinamide (Vitamin B3, Nicotinamide)
molecules.label_th: ไนอาซินาไมด์
molecules.role: Precursor of NAD+/NADP+; reduces transepidermal water loss, blocks melanosome transfer to keratinocytes; anti-inflammatory at 2-10%

molecules.name: Glutathione (GSH, γ-Glu-Cys-Gly)
molecules.label_th: กลูตาไธโอน
molecules.role: Master intracellular antioxidant; inhibits tyrosinase; oral bioavailability disputed — IV route used clinically in Asia for brightening

molecules.name: Astaxanthin
molecules.label_th: แอสต้าแซนทีน
molecules.role: Membrane-spanning carotenoid — singlet-oxygen quenching ~100× β-carotene and ~6000× vitamin C in specific chemiluminescence assays; from Haematococcus pluvialis algae

molecules.name: MMP-1 (Collagenase-1)
molecules.label_th: MMP-1 (คอลลาเจนเนส-1)
molecules.role: Cleaves collagen types I, II, III at a single site in the triple helix — primary enzyme of photoaging collagen breakdown

molecules.name: MMP-9 (Gelatinase-B)
molecules.role: Degrades denatured collagen (gelatin) + type IV basement-membrane collagen; upregulated in UV and inflammation

molecules.name: Pentosidine (AGE)
molecules.label_th: เพนโตซิดีน (AGE)
molecules.role: Fluorescent crosslink between lysine and arginine via glucose; accumulates with age and hyperglycemia in skin collagen — biomarker of skin glycation

molecules.name: CML (Nε-carboxymethyl-lysine)
molecules.role: Most-studied AGE; RAGE receptor ligand → oxidative stress + MMPs → accelerated skin aging

molecules.name: MITF (microphthalmia transcription factor)
molecules.role: Master regulator of melanocyte biology — activates tyrosinase, TYRP1, DCT gene transcription; downstream of α-MSH/MC1R

molecules.name: Tyrosinase
molecules.role: Rate-limiting enzyme of melanogenesis — oxidizes tyrosine → DOPA → dopaquinone; target of arbutin, kojic acid, hydroquinone, vitamin C

molecules.name: Cutibacterium acnes (formerly P. acnes)
molecules.label_th: ซี. แอคเนส
molecules.role: Commensal of pilosebaceous unit; strain-specific IA1 drives inflammatory acne via TLR-2 → IL-1α/IL-8

molecules.name: Sebum (sebaceous lipid)
molecules.label_th: ซีบัม / น้ำมันผิว
molecules.role: Triglycerides (~40%), wax esters (~25%), squalene (~12%), cholesterol esters (~2%); androgen-driven; squalene oxidation → comedogenic

organizations.name: University of Michigan Department of Dermatology

case_studies.name: Proksch 2014 VERISOL® RCT
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Double-blind placebo-controlled trial in 114 women aged 45-65 — 2.5 g bioactive collagen peptides daily for 8 weeks reduced eye wrinkle volume by 20% (p<0.05) and increased procollagen I content 65% in skin biopsies
case_studies.source: Proksch E et al., Skin Pharmacol Physiol 2014 (PMID 24401291)

case_studies.name: Fisher 2002 NEJM — UV and MMP pathway
case_studies.claim_to_fame: In vivo human study — a single UV exposure (2 MED) induced MMP-1, MMP-3, MMP-9 mRNA within 8-24 hours via AP-1 transcription; established the molecular mechanism of photoaging
case_studies.source: Fisher GJ et al., N Engl J Med 2002 (doi 10.1056/NEJM199711133372003 — earlier 1997 paper; mechanism review Arch Dermatol 2002)

case_studies.name: Kligman 1986 Tretinoin for Photoaging
case_studies.claim_to_fame: First landmark double-blind trial showing 0.05% tretinoin cream reduces photoaging wrinkles and roughness after 24 weeks of daily use
case_studies.source: Kligman AM et al., J Am Acad Dermatol 1986

case_studies.name: Shuster 1975 Collagen Density & Age
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Cross-sectional skin biopsy study (N=177, ages 15-93) — dermal collagen density declines linearly ~1% per year after age 20; basis of the 'collagen loss 1%/year' doctrine
case_studies.source: Shuster S et al., Br J Dermatol 1975

case_studies.name: Brincat Menopause Collagen Study
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Women lose approximately 30% of skin collagen in the first 5 years after menopause, plateauing to ~2.1% / year after — anchor for 'estrogen-collagen' narratives
case_studies.source: Brincat M et al., Obstet Gynecol 1987; restated Brincat 2005 Climacteric

case_studies.name: Hakozaki 2002 Niacinamide RCT
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Double-blind split-face trial — 5% niacinamide topical reduced hyperpigmentation significantly vs vehicle at 8 weeks; mechanism = blocked melanosome transfer to keratinocytes (in vitro 35-68% reduction)
case_studies.source: Hakozaki T et al., Br J Dermatol 2002

case_studies.name: Nishida 2007 Astaxanthin Singlet-Oxygen Assay
case_studies.claim_to_fame: In vitro chemiluminescence study — astaxanthin quenched singlet oxygen ~100-550× more than β-carotene and several thousand-fold more than water-soluble antioxidants (ascorbate, tocopherol) in specific lipid-phase assays — source of the '6000× vitamin C' marketing stat
case_studies.source: Nishida Y, Yamashita E, Miki W, Carotenoid Sci 2007 — industry-cited in vitro comparison
